name: HEDISCoreClaimProfessionalNonClinician
title: HEDIS Core Claim Professional NonClinician
description: The HEDIS Core Professional NonClinician Claim profile extends the core resource to include requirements for measure calculation.

element.definition: [HEDIS][CARIN-BB] The metadata about a resource. This is content in the resource that is maintained by the infrastructure. Changes to the content might not always be associated with version changes to the resource.
[CARIN-BB] The category of claim, e.g. oral, pharmacy, vision, institutional, professional.
[HEDIS][CARIN-BB] The party to whom the professional services and/or products have been supplied or are being considered and for whom actual or forecast reimbursement is sought.

element.comment: [HEDIS][CARIN-BB] Typically this would be today or in the past for a claim, and today or in the future for preauthorizations and predeterminations. Typically line item dates of service should fall within the billing period if one is specified.

element.definition: [HEDIS] A number to uniquely identify care team entries.
[HEDIS][CARIN-BB] Member of the team who provided the product or service.
[HEDIS] Information about diagnoses relevant to the claim items.
[HEDIS] A number to uniquely identify diagnosis entries.
[CARIN-BB] The nature of illness or problem in a coded form or as a reference to an external defined Condition.
[CARIN-BB] When the condition was observed or the relative ranking.

binding.description: Timing or nature of the diagnosis

element.definition: [HEDIS] Procedures performed on the patient relevant to the billing items with the claim.
[HEDIS] A number to uniquely identify procedure entries.
[HEDIS] The code or reference to a Procedure resource which identifies the clinical intervention performed.
[HEDIS][CARIN-BB] A claim line. Either a simple  product or service or a 'group' of details which can each be a simple items or groups of sub-details.
[CARIN-BB] A number to uniquely identify item entries.
[HEDIS] Diagnosis applicable for this service or product.
[HEDIS] Procedures applicable for this service or product.
[HEDIS] The type of revenue or cost center providing the product and/or service.
[CARIN-BB] When the value is a group code then this item collects a set of related claim details, otherwise this contains the product, service, drug or other billing code for the item.

binding.description: Billing, service, product, or drug code

element.definition: [CARIN-BB] Item typification or modifiers codes to convey additional context for the product or service.
[HEDIS] The date or dates when the service or product was supplied, performed or completed.
element.comment: The line item SHALL contain the date of service for an outpatient event or the admit and  discharge date for an inpatient event in ‘serviced’. This may mean iterating the admit and discharge date onto multiple rows if there are multiple line items. For pharmacy claims, this date  SHALL be the date of the dispensing event.

element.definition: [HEDIS][CARIN-BB] Where the product or service was provided.

binding.description: Place of service or where product was supplied

element.definition: [HEDIS] The number of repetitions of a service or product.
